conditions: Partner must implement an IAB approved consent management platform (CMP)
Partner is required to ensure that the Outbrain widget can receive and process the consent signal
Compliance with GDPR and CCPA when handling user consent
effects: Enables Outbrain to collect consent and opt-out data
Ensures compliance with legal requirements in regions like the EU and California

conditions: For SDK implementations, the partner must implement an IAB approved CMP
For iOS, Outbrain SDK version should be 3.8.6 or higher
For Android, Outbrain SDK version should be 3.9.1 or higher
effects: Allows Outbrain to retrieve and process consent strings according to IAB TCF V2.0

conditions: For users in California, the partner must pass on the CCPA consent signal
effects: Users can opt out of the Sale of Personal Information
